title: Rippers Unmasked — Hoplosphere Economy
description: The Lodge's harvested-hoplosphere crafting economy for Rippers Unmasked: monster material → shards → hoplospheres, plus the accessory setting recipe. Ships a Fabricate crafting-system file (import via game.fabricate.api.importSystemFromFile) and the component Item compendium it binds — shards, matrices, tools, sphere outputs, remnants and accessories. Built source-faithfully from the hoplosphere-economy brief; no invented rules values. Requires the 'fabricate' module. Personal-table module — not for redistribution.

rippers-hoplosphere.note: Two artefacts. (1) packs/components — a native Project FU Item compendium (type:treasure) of every document the crafting graph references: 6 shards, 6 clotted remains, 7 matrices, 2 tools, 14 sphere outputs + slag, 3 remnants, 7 accessories, 21 recipe cards. (2) system/rippers-hoplosphere-system.json — a Fabricate crafting-system file at schemaVersion 4 (Fabricate 1.9.2 — the installed build) that game.fabricate.api.importSystemFromFile() consumes; its essenceDefinitions/components/tools/recipeItemDefinitions + top-level recipes bind REAL Compendium.rippers-hoplosphere.components.Item.<id> UUIDs (originItemUuid + registeredItemUuid) from pack (1). Built by tools/build-hoplosphere.mjs from lodge-docs 'Look Here Claude/hoplosphere-economy-brief.md' — source-faithful, no re-pricing, no invented rules values (⚠ owed markers where TFA sphere/accessory mechanics would go). Per-recipe DC via recipe.dcOverride (DECOCTION 13 vs system default 10) — one system, no split. THE SCORCH uses resultSelection routedByCheck + system.craftingCheck.routed (GM wires macros/scorch-check.js via routed.macroUuid after import). RENDERING via component.salvage.resultGroups (+ salvageCraftingCheck.progressive rollFormula 1d2, tunable). features.gathering is OFF: the Susurrus gathering environment is not yet authored (its element shape needs a live populated-gathering export); Susurrus material still flows through the shard components. Emotion/denial aspect register is GM-side only and appears in NO string here (brief §3.4). No FU or Fabricate content is redistributed; no automation code beyond the shipped Scorch check macro.
